name: Can I replace an angle stop valve myself, or should I hire a professional?

mainEntity.name: Can I replace an angle stop valve myself, or should I hire a professional?

acceptedAnswer.text: While it's possible for an experienced DIYer to replace an angle stop valve, hiring a professional plumber is often recommended to prevent potential water damage or improper installation. A practical tradeoff is balancing potential savings against the risk of leaks, which can be costly to repair. Professional plumbers ensure proper shut-off of the main water supply, correct valve installation, and thorough leak testing, providing peace of mind.
acceptedAnswer.description: While DIY is possible, hiring a professional plumber is recommended to avoid leaks and ensure proper installation, preventing potential water damage.
